update.networkIssue: Network issue. Check connection or use a proxy.
update.signatureIssue: macOS install validation failed. The update package is not code signed, so auto install cannot continue. Please download the new version manually.
update.installIssue: The update package was downloaded, but installation failed. Quit Track Studio and try again, or download the latest version manually.
update.unknownIssue: The update flow failed unexpectedly. Please try again later. If it keeps failing, download the latest version manually.
update.goneIssue: This update can't continue. Please check for a newer version.
update.downloadCompleted: Download done. Track Studio will update after restart.
update.updateDownloaded: Update downloaded. Restart Track Studio now to finish the upgrade.
update.preparingInstall: Update downloaded. Verifying and preparing installation. Track Studio will upgrade after you quit the app.
update.manualCloseWarning: Before replacing the old version, quit the Track Studio that is currently running. You can use the button below.
update.manualStepOpenFile: 1. When the download finishes, Track Studio will try to open the downloaded file for you. If you still do not see Track Studio, use the buttons below.
update.manualStepCloseApp: 2. Before replacing the old version, click Quit Track Studio to close the running app.
update.manualStepReplaceApp: 3. When you see Track Studio, drag it into Applications.
update.manualStepReplaceConfirm: 4. If macOS asks whether to replace the old version, click Replace.
update.manualStepOpenFromApps: 5. When that is done, open Track Studio from Applications.
update.manualStepRightClickOpen: 6. If it does not open the first time, right-click the Track Studio icon and choose Open.
